Hello, this is the notice of the publication of the Minneapolis VA Health Care System Ground Ambulance Solicitation and Pre-Solcitation (Solicitation #: 36C26326Q0088).

The question deadline is 03/13/2026, 17:00 Central Time.
The offer deadline is 03/25/2026, 17:00 Central Time.

Read all of the directions very carefully and make sure to follow them.  Make sure to pay extra attention to the Addendum to Instructions to Offerors FAR 52.212-1 for offer submission instructions.

Always utilize the most recent version of the solicitation posting on SAM.gov to avoid issues with out of date forms or information
